findings.title: Comando completo com quantidade explícita fica preso na clarificação anterior
findings.reason: The analyzer returned quantity_conflict before checking semantic incompatibility for a complete quantity-first food command, preventing the central gate from superseding the prior pending operation.
findings.literal_case: pending 2 fatias de pão de forma Panco; next message 100 g de banana; expected superseded pending and normal new-command flow.
